Welcome to Hira School

A Legacy of Academic Excellence & Moral Tarbiyah

At Hira School — Shamim Saeed Campus (Sukkur Township), we believe that real education extends beyond textbooks. Our institution offers modern scientific education harmoniously blended with Islamic character building.

We provide a disciplined, safe, and nurturing environment with modern facilities, ensuring that every student develops academically while growing in confidence, character, and leadership.

  • Integrated Modern & Islamic Curriculum
  • Highly Qualified & Dedicated Teaching Faculty
  • Focus on Character Building, Hifz & Public Speaking

Academic Journey

Playgroup to Matric

Age-appropriate learning stages with academic foundations, practical skills, and Islamic Tarbiyah.

Early Years

Playgroup, Nursery & KG
Activity-based learning, motor skills, phonics, basic concepts, creative arts, and foundational Islamic Tarbiyah.

Primary

Classes 1–5
English fluency, Mathematics, Science, Computer skills, and Islamic ethics with strong foundations.

Middle

Classes 6–8
Critical thinking, computer literacy, practical science, and analytical skill building.

Matric

Classes 9–10
Board exam preparation, concept-based science, lab work, and individual career counseling.
